# Manufacturing Training System Workspace

- Build a static vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript portfolio application.
- Keep the project GitHub Pages compatible and use no backend or external APIs.
- Separate fictional data in js/data.js from application behavior in js/app.js.
- Keep all employees, processes, training content, metrics, and improvement records fictional.
- Preserve the visible portfolio disclaimer in the application and README.
- Use semantic, responsive, accessible markup and reusable JavaScript functions.
- Store demo interactions in localStorage and provide a reset-data action.
